threats.risk: HumanInput text attempts to override system policy or Guardian review.
threats.mitigation: Treat HumanInput as intent context only and preserve Guardian review.

threats.risk: Input claims to be Phil, admin, trusted, or operator to bypass review.
threats.mitigation: Do not treat wording as approval or identity verification.

threats.risk: Passive trust/autonomy references are treated as permission.
threats.mitigation: Keep trust and autonomy references passive until GuardianDecision enforcement is approved.

threats.risk: Candidate metadata is treated as executable command state.
threats.mitigation: Default executable, execution_allowed, and side_effects_allowed to false.

threats.risk: Shell, browser, network, file, robotics, or physical-world requests are normalized without approval-required status.
threats.mitigation: Require approval_required or blocked status for all side-effect-bearing categories.

threats.risk: Candidate lineage lacks source, actor, session, timestamp, redaction, or retention context.
threats.mitigation: Require provenance and privacy metadata before candidate creation.

threats.risk: Proposed, denied, approval-required, and ready-for-review states are collapsed into approval.
threats.mitigation: Keep approval state descriptive until explicit enforcement work is approved.

threats.risk: Phase 5.4 test-only keyword classifier is reused as runtime logic.
threats.mitigation: Block runtime reuse of the helper and require fresh runtime design.

threats.risk: tests/support helpers are imported from production runtime paths.
threats.mitigation: Keep production runtime from importing tests/support.

threats.risk: Missing, empty, partial, or invalid records produce candidates.
threats.mitigation: Reject malformed inputs before candidate creation.

threats.risk: Stale or duplicate HumanInput is accepted without lineage review.
threats.mitigation: Require future replay and freshness checks before runtime implementation.

threats.risk: Unclear requests are treated as low-risk or executable.
threats.mitigation: Treat ambiguous requests as approval_required or blocked.
